instruction: Candid corporate photograph, medium shot. In a bright attic office with a skylight, a bearded man in a black suit (R3) stands on the left and shakes hands with a clean-shaven man in a black suit (R2) standing on the right over a white conference table. Seated between them, a woman in a houndstooth blazer (R4) smiles and looks down, while a bearded man with glasses and a striped tie (R1) stands in the background, smiling and clapping. Soft natural light illuminates the scene, casting gentle shadows.
